# Review - PR 578 @ a9e6c2644ffc3a04e04a4c0fd733b9ee31c0e1f5

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 034fe63d193bc24f1a3cae12f5ea83b0874b6555. Documentation-only change of 98 added and 3 removed lines in two protocol files (`local/protocols/review.md`, `local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md`) recording the owner's 2026-09-17 session-independence ruling for Opus helper reviews; no Lean, blueprint or script content is touched.

## Findings

- none

## Review

Base `main`; merge-base 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10; two commits (db8edcef, a9e6c264); full main-relative diff read line by line. The published head matches the reviewed sha. There are no earlier marked reviews on this PR, so no prior finding had to be re-checked.

Checked and confirmed:

- **Faithfulness to the recorded owner decisions** (the governance analogue of source faithfulness here, since no paper-labelled declaration is touched). Every substantive claim in both files matches the durable record on `github/main` in `results/telemetry/events.md`: the 11:22Z owner decisions (six Mac slots, three fixers and three reviewers; fresh agent that never touched the PR; personas and policy from `github/main`; read-only; marked exact-head COMMENT review with a parseable verdict; no helper-posted statuses; MAIN runs the fail-closed check), the 11:37Z interim family-exclusion tightening now recorded as superseded, and the 12:29Z OWNER RULING that a new Opus session counts as independent, including on Opus-repaired PRs, with MAIN keeping the fail-closed status check. Relay-1 plus one native delegate and caps 0/0/0 are stated unchanged, matching the same record. Nothing in the diff grants a helper new authority: no key, gate, cap, merge or project-goal change, and the new text explicitly keeps the provenance and handback checks as operator duties rather than claiming script enforcement.
- **No weakening of merge evidence.** The new §11 subsection retains green exact-head CI (§2), trusted sources from published main (§3), untrusted-diff handling (§4), the return contract (§6), the findings ledger (§9), the round cap (§12) and the whitespace-sensitive carry rule (§13), and it restates that only `APPROVED` or `COMMENTED` with an empty unchecked ledger can receive `local-review/summary=success`, with adverse, absent, stale or malformed evidence failing closed. The reviewer is explicitly barred from editing, running CI, posting statuses or merging.
- **Mechanical accuracy of the new instructions.** `local/bin/gh_common.py` really provides `post-review <number> <commit_id> <marker> --body-file` and `pr-reviews <number>` (which returns the raw review rows, so the documented `commit_id` check is possible); the documented claim lines `opus-review <PR> claimed ...` and `opus-review <PR> released <VERDICT> head=<sha> review=<id>` match the shapes `qpbt-claim.sh` appends to `watchdog/meta-dispatched.txt`. The softened sentences about `dispatch.sh` ("Standard scripted code and prose reviews..." and "Every codex invocation made by `review.sh`...") remain true of the scripted path and do not disable the fail-closed dispatcher requirement or `LOCAL_REVIEW_ENABLED`.
- **Conventions.** Both EVOLUTION entries follow the established Trigger / Change / Expected effect shape of the neighbouring entries, are placed in date order at the end of the file, and assert no throughput gain before observation. The longest added line is 83 characters, within the 100-character limit in `AGENTS.md`. No `sorry`, `axiom`, statement change or proof content is involved.
- **CI at this exact head**: all nine statuses successful (`local-ci/build`, `blueprint-render`, `blueprint-sync`, `paper-gaps`, `file-length`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion`, `statement-origin`, `summary`).

Two non-blocking observations, neither a merge condition: (1) `local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md:1179-1180` cites the 12:29Z ruling only through `/tmp/qpbt-main-handoff-v5.md`, a path outside the repository, although the same ruling is durably recorded in `results/telemetry/events.md` ("2026-09-17 META 12:29Z OWNER RULING") the way the sibling entry cites it; adding that locator on a later touch would make the record self-contained. (2) "the cap in §12" is slightly ambiguous because `review.md` already carries two `## 12.` headings on main ("Deliberately not ported" and "Round cap and operator adjudication"); the pre-existing style disambiguates by naming the section. Neither is introduced drift and neither affects the rule being recorded.

Not checked: nothing was built or elaborated, since the diff contains no Lean, blueprint TeX or script; I did not verify the contents of the non-repository handoff file; I did not re-verify the CI run itself beyond the published exact-head statuses.

VERDICT: APPROVED (code=APPROVED, prose=n/a)
